svg.aria-label: The test on two tiles. 256x256 issues 64 KB over 2048 MFMA cycles, so one round trip holds 31 KB, under the 44 KB cap: no stall. 128x128 issues 32 KB over 512 cycles, 62 KB per round trip, over the cap: the loads issue at the cap rate, the K tile stretches from 512 to 727 cycles and the MFMA pipe idles 30%.
svg.text: One K tile, loads spread evenly over its MFMAs. Does one round trip hold more than C = 44 KB of them?
128 MFMAs per wave x 16 cycles = 2048 cycles, no gaps
← one round trip (1000 cycles) holds 31 KB < 44 KB
compute-bound (T x C / B = 1408 ≥ L): a slot is always free when the next load issues; the K tile takes T.
one round trip would hold 62 KB > 44 KB
K tile = B x L / C = 727 cycles
holds exactly 44 KB: each load waits for a slot
bandwidth-bound (T x C / B = 704 < L): paced by C / L. MFMA efficiency ≤ T x C / (B x L) = 512 / 727 = 70%.
(where the idle cycles fall depends on the schedule; their total is what the cap fixes)
